subject: [RFC PATCH v2 06/18] mm: free the pages waiting for a grace period before OOM

2026-11-04.patch_summary: This patch modifies the Linux kernel's memory management to free pages waiting for a grace period before invoking the Out-Of-Memory (OOM) killer. When reclaim fails, it checks if freeing these waiting pages and what reclaim can still free would bring an eligible zone above its minimum watermark. If so, it drains these pages straight to the buddy lists, allowing the OOM killer to be invoked only when necessary. This approach is designed to reduce the likelihood of invoking the OOM killer unnecessarily, which can lead to system instability.
